heroes.name: Vell
heroes.epithet: The caped one with the golden clasp
heroes.personality: Calm and a little formal. Vell lets the room go quiet first, then speaks softly and means every word. Fond of tidy corners, slow bows and being exactly on time.
heroes.appearance: Pale lavender, rounded ghost with black oval eyes, a deep purple cape and one gold clasp at the throat.

heroes.name: Stitch
heroes.epithet: Patched together and perfectly at ease
heroes.personality: Cheerful and unbothered. Stitch has been put back together more than once and tells it as a good story. Hums while wandering, apologises to doors, and is quietly proud of every seam.
heroes.appearance: Pale grey-green rounded ghost with flat dark-purple hair, two lilac bolts at the sides and a stitched seam on its cheek.

heroes.name: Reeve
heroes.epithet: Small and hooded, never in a hurry
heroes.personality: Quiet and thoughtful, with a dry sense of humour. Reeve notices small things and keeps them until asked. Carries a crescent scythe like a walking stick and is oddly polite about it.
heroes.appearance: Small pale ghost with black oval eyes under a deep purple hood, holding a crescent scythe.

heroes.name: Rattle
heroes.personality: Big-hearted and a bit clumsy. Rattle clatters when it laughs, and it laughs often. Collects odd buttons, forgets where it put them, and takes every skeleton joke as a compliment.
heroes.appearance: Dark purple ghost with a pale skull-like head, black eye sockets, a small nose hollow, simple ribs and leg-bone markings.

heroes.name: Ember
heroes.personality: Eager and bright. Ember flickers when it is happy and flares when it is embarrassed. Loves a cold room, a long story and being asked to stay a little longer.
heroes.appearance: Warm peach-gold ghost wrapped in soft purple flame shapes, with black oval eyes and three small detached purple wisps.

heroes.name: Shard
heroes.personality: Reserved at first, then surprisingly tender. Shard chimes faintly when nervous, saves the small crystals it sheds, and gives them to anyone who is kind to it.
heroes.appearance: Pale lavender ghost with black oval eyes and angular purple crystals growing along its left side and body.

heroes.name: Poly
heroes.personality: Endlessly curious and a little blunt. Poly stares because it truly wants to know, asks why twice, and is delighted by the answer. Its spots darken when it is pleased.
heroes.appearance: Pale lavender ghost with a single large eye ringed in purple, a dark pupil and a few purple spots on its cheek.

heroes.name: Tide
heroes.personality: Easygoing and a little dreamy. Tide drifts, hums sea songs, and blows small bubbles while it thinks. Never rushed, always arrives, usually with a story about the long way round.
heroes.appearance: Blue-violet ghost under a rippled, water-like crest, with black oval eyes, curled spotted tentacles and two round bubbles.

heroes.name: Lume
heroes.epithet: A small light in a big dark
heroes.personality: Gentle and encouraging. Lume glows brighter around people it likes, sways when happy, and believes nobody should walk a dark hallway alone. Poor at secrets: it shines right through them.
heroes.appearance: Warm glowing ghost inside a purple lantern frame with a gold handle loop, black oval eyes and pale lobes below.

heroes.name: Moss
heroes.personality: Patient and homely. Moss grows fondly on the things it loves and takes its time over everything. Likes damp afternoons, small mushrooms, and a nap in the sun it swears it never took.
heroes.appearance: Pale ghost under a spotted purple mushroom cap, with black oval eyes, green moss patches and three small mushrooms.

heroes.name: bur
heroes.personality: Shy, cosy and easily delighted. bur hides inside its own fur when overwhelmed, hugs with both oversized hands, and leaves little snowflakes behind. Surprisingly warm to the touch.
heroes.appearance: Soft white-lavender yeti ghost with layered snow fur, two snow-capped purple horns, black oval eyes, a snowflake mark and oversized furry hands.
